sentences.englishText: Sir Ernest Shackleton was an Irish explorer who led one of the most remarkable Antarctic expeditions in history.
sentences.turkishText: Sir Ernest Shackleton, tarihin en dikkat çekici Antarktika seferlerinden birini liderlik eden İrlandalı bir kaşifti.

sentences.englishText: In 1914, Shackleton attempted to cross Antarctica but his ship Endurance became trapped in ice.
sentences.turkishText: 1914'te Shackleton, Antarktika'yı geçmeye çalıştı ancak Endurance gemisi buzda sıkıştı.

sentences.englishText: When the ship was destroyed, Shackleton and his crew survived for months on Elephant Island with little food.
sentences.turkishText: Gemi yok edildiğinde, Shackleton ve mürettebatı Elephant Adasında az yiyecekle aylarca hayatta kaldı.

sentences.englishText: Shackleton made an incredible eight hundred mile journey in a small boat to reach South Georgia for help.
sentences.turkishText: Shackleton, yardım için South Georgia'ya ulaşmak için küçük bir teknede inanılmaz bir sekiz yüz millik yolculuk yaptı.

sentences.englishText: Shackleton successfully rescued all twenty-two men from Elephant Island, two years after the expedition began.
sentences.turkishText: Shackleton, seferden iki yıl sonra Elephant Adası'ndaki tüm yirmi iki adamı başarıyla kurtardı.

sentences.englishText: Shackleton died in 1922 while preparing for another Antarctic expedition and was buried at sea.
sentences.turkishText: Shackleton, 1922'de başka bir Antarktika seferine hazırlanırken öldü ve denize gömüldü.

enrichment.summary: Sir Ernest Shackleton was an Irish explorer who led one of the most remarkable Antarctic expeditions in history. In 1914, Shackleton attempted to cross Antarctica but his ship Endurance became trapped in ice.
